**What this changes, for the person using Switchboard**


**Checks**
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Ran it in a browser, light and dark
- [ ] New feature or connection: entry in `public/setup.js`, paragraph in `README.md`
- [ ] New dependency: a line in `docs/DECISIONS.md` saying why
- [ ] Touches Mac or Windows paths: ran there, or marked unverified in the description
- [ ] No personal data in code, docs or fixtures
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), agreeing to CONTRIBUTING.md
